All tests pass (27/27), and it's the only `*AgentTest.java` in the project. I created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/time/FastDatePrinterAgentTest.java`, a self-contained JUnit 5 test class covering `FastDatePrinter`:

- Basic formatting (Date/Calendar/long millis), `Appendable`/`StringBuffer` overloads, package-private `format(Object)` and deprecated `format(Object, StringBuffer, FieldPosition)` including the unsupported-type `IllegalArgumentException`
- Getters, `equals`/`hashCode` contract, `toString`
- Constructor edge cases: null pattern (NPE), null locale (defaults), null time zone (NPE on use)
- Invalid pattern letter and invalid `X` repeat count (`IllegalArgumentException`)
- Literal text/escaped-quote parsing, 2-digit vs 4-digit year padding, 12/24-hour midnight boundary mapping, AM/PM and era fields, numeric day-of-week, the lang3-specific `Z`/`ZZ`/`ZZZ` and `X`/`XX`/`XXX` time-zone rules (including zero-offset special case), negative proleptic week-year sign handling
- A broad cross-check of many pattern letters against `java.text.SimpleDateFormat` across several dates/time zones
